name: Openverse API
category: A13. Reference data and asset sources
role: Search openly licensed images by licence, with creator and attribution fields
summary: Remote HTTP search over openly licensed images and audio gathered from Flickr, Wikimedia and others. Each result carries licence, version, licence URL, creator, source URL and an attribution string; license= and license_type= filters narrow before use. Index, not host.
use_when: Finding candidate photos whose licence is machine-readable, filtered to CC0 or public domain
Building a credits slate: attribution, creator and landing URL come with each result
Image selection for the image-director before the file is copied into an asset store
avoid_when: Reproducible renders: results and ids change, and files live on third-party sites
Anything without a local copy and rights evidence recorded (ADR 0011 asset rule)
Inspiration to look at: the workspace inspiration library holds those, not this API
notes: 2026-11-27: Code is MIT (WordPress/openverse, pushed 2026-11-27). Licences on results vary and include NC, ND and SA; filter with license=cc0,pdm or license_type=commercial,modification. Labels are aggregated from sources and not verified by Openverse.

2026-11-27: Anonymous limits differ by endpoint: /v1/ reported 20/min and 200/day, /v1/images/ reported 100/min and 1000/day. Search returned 504 for several attempts before recovering; retry with back-off.

assessment.rationale: Free-software code (MIT), anonymous HTTP, no install. Fills an asset-source gap: iconify supplies licensed icons, nothing supplies licensed photos. It is a search service and not a store; ADR 0011 keeps a fetched file an inspiration item until a copy and rights evidence exist, so it stays a candidate.

evidence.result: license=cc0 and license=pdm searches returned only results with matching license and licence_url; commercial,modification returned no nc/nd; one detail had all 10 attribution fields; 7/7 checks, 4 requests.
evidence.scope: Anonymous live images search, structure only, no ids or counts; not label accuracy at source, downloads, audio or registered use; run skips if unreachable.
